metadata.question: Did the water extent in the northern part of Lake Eyre increase between June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 surface reflectance (10 m) over Lake Eyre to map open water by MNDWI for June 20 and Sep 15, 2025. - Collection: COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED - Date windows: ±7 days around each target date - Location: northern lobe of Lake Eyre (polygon around -28.4, 137.3) 2. Masking: - Apply SCL-based cloud mask (keep 4,5,6) - Compute MNDWI = (Green − SWIR)/(Green + SWIR); threshold ≥ 0.2 to label water - Reproject to 30 m for fast regional stats (still ≈ 0.3 M pixels, safe) 3. Logic: - If either window yields 0 images → C1 - After compositing & masking, if valid-pixel count = 0 → C2 - Compute water area (ha) for each composite; compare Sep vs Jun - If Sep area > Jun area → A, else B - If any area result is None/NaN → C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. northern Lake Eyre geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-137.6,-28.2],[-137.0,-28.2],[-137.0,-28.6],[-137.6,-28.6]]) def roi_water(d): c = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')\ .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(ee.Date(d).advance(-7,'day'),ee.Date(d).advance(7,'day')) n = c.size().getInfo() print(f"{d} images: {n}") if n==0: print("C1"); raise SystemExit comp = c.map(lambda i: i.updateMask(i.select('SCL').gte(4).And(i.select('SCL').lte(6))))\ .median().clip(geom) mndwi = comp.normalizedDifference(['B3','B11']).rename('mndwi') water = mndwi.gte(0.2) px = water.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).get('mndwi').getInfo() if px is None or px==0: print("C2"); raise SystemExit return px*900/1e4 # ha jun = roi_water('2025-06-20') sep = roi_water('2025-09-15') print(f"Jun water: {jun:.0f} ha, Sep water: {sep:.0f} ha") if sep > jun: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. northern Lake Eyre
geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-137.6,-28.2],[-137.0,-28.2],[-137.0,-28.6],[-137.6,-28.6]])

def roi_water(d):
    c = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')\
           .filterBounds(geom).filterDate(ee.Date(d).advance(-7,'day'),ee.Date(d).advance(7,'day'))
    n = c.size().getInfo()
    print(f"{d} images: {n}")
    if n==0:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>"); raise SystemExit
    comp = c.map(lambda i: i.updateMask(i.select('SCL').gte(4).And(i.select('SCL').lte(6))))\
            .median().clip(geom)
    mndwi = comp.normalizedDifference(['B3','B11']).rename('mndwi')
    water = mndwi.gte(0.2)
    px = water.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=30,
                            maxPixels=1e9).get('mndwi').getInfo()
    if px is None or px==0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>"); raise SystemExit
    return px*900/1e4   # ha

jun = roi_water('2025-06-20')
sep = roi_water('2025-09-15')

print(f"Jun water: {jun:.0f} ha, Sep water: {sep:.0f} ha")
if sep > jun:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
